description: A declares "0.1", so its top-level extension data is opaque and the outlet X4 in it is no element of A (0.3). The batch makes the document declare "0.2", which turns X4 into an extension element of the working copy; the next device placed is X5, because minting counts the IDs in the working copy as it stands (1.5). "created" lists both: X4 is an element of B and was none of A (1.3).
